salary.filename: Employee Pay Rate Report as of 11-23-2026.xlsx

allowances.method: All three scanned pages visually transcribed; every department subtotal and grand total reconciled.

notes.salary: Source Annual column, as reported; current pay rates, not payroll paid or total compensation. No extra hours or benefits have been assumed.
notes.scope: Payroll department totals, not a fund allocation. These figures are not added to the spending totals.
notes.allowances: Gross amounts in the supplied car-allowance report, grouped by primary department and work date. This period is longer than a fiscal year. It is not a payment-by-payment register.
notes.periodResolution: The PDF header on all three pages says Work Date 10/01/25–10/26/26, superseding the shorter period described in the email.
notes.coverage: A department absent from the allowance report has no listed entries; this does not establish that no vehicle-related costs were incurred.

1615.sharedScope: The same payroll department appears in multiple fund cards. These are the same department-wide figures, not separate amounts to add together; the reports do not provide a fund split.
